title: New offer
summary: Diceroll's New offer editor before anything exists on a store: What it sells (Table themes, an add-on, one-time), the base price empty with 'Set a base price', and SKU rows that create the App Store and Google Play products from the offer once it is saved and priced, with Steam as a copy card plus a DLC picker and itch.io explained.
compare: Order: What it sells, Price and territories, SKUs, then the save row; the status reads 'Draft, not saved' as muted status text with a pencil.

Offer id is an editable mono field made from the name, with the rule that it is fixed once the first SKU exists; Sells uses the kit's default-size segmented control and names the add-on's kind (non-consumable: bought once, restored everywhere). Quantity appears only for a consumable add-on.
Base price is empty with the placeholder 'Set a base price' and a hint naming real Apple price points; territories default to Diceroll's (174 of 175, not China mainland) with the reason.

App Store and Google Play rows preview the product id and type Polaris Key will create and carry 'Create on App Store' / 'Create on Google Play', disabled until the offer is saved and priced (the foot says so). Create opens the L1 confirm (commerce.create-iap).
Steam has no create API: a copy card with the name to paste in Steamworks and a picker of Diceroll's DLC read from Steam; never a typed DLC id. itch.io says it sells the game only.
Save draft (primary) and Cancel sit in the save row; nothing sells until a SKU is on sale.
Phone: the two-column fields stack; SKU actions go under their text; the Steam copy card and picker stack full width.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
B17: Sells carries license (it picks what the license gets); the rest of the offer is commerce.

findings.issue: SKU rows uneven, Steam link high, no way to edit territories, SKUs subtitle, Save draft enabled with nothing priced.
findings.resolution: Same layout as offer (rail from 1200px); Steamworks is an outline button on the button edge; SKUs subtitle deleted; Edit link beside 174 of 175; base price marked required; 'Needs a base price' beside a disabled Save draft; phone bottom bar. Rows in the 360px rail drop their buttons under the text, so heights differ only where a row has two actions.

findings.issue: [wide 1920] Console pages stretch tables and attention rows across the whole width.
findings.resolution: Page content is capped at 1280px, left-aligned, from 1600px (.cm2 page cap); attention text is capped at 72ch with its action beside it.
